Step 1: 1192 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not a century exception because 1192 < 1600).  
Step 2: 05-28-1192 + 84 days.  
From May 28 to May 31: 3 days (remainder 81 days).  
June: 30 days → remainder 51 days.  
July: 31 days → remainder 20 days.  
August 20 days → August 20, 1192.
